'''My First Wide: Volume 1''' (Japanese: '''My First WIDE: ポケットモンスターSPECIAL ルビーサファイア編 1''' ''My First Wide: {{tt|Pocket Monster Special|Pokémon Adventures}} Ruby Sapphire Chapter volume 1'') is the first volume of an omnibus compilation of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. It is authored by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and illustrated by [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. It contains chapters originally included in {{PAV|15}}, {{PAV|16}} and {{PAV|17}}.

==Major events==
{{spoilers}}
* {{Adv|Ruby}} moves from [[Johto]] to [[Littleroot Town]] in [[Hoenn]].
* Ruby arrives at his new house, but quickly runs away.
* Ruby meets [[Professor Birch]].
* Ruby meets {{Adv|Sapphire}}.
* Sapphire is revealed to own a Pokédex.
* Ruby and Sapphire make a bet to see who can beat their respective goals in eighty days.
* Ruby meets {{adv|Wally}}.
* Ruby helps Wally capture his first Pokémon, a {{p|Kecleon}}.
* Ruby is swept out to sea after an earthquake.
* [[Gabby and Ty]] are attacked by [[Team Aqua]]'s {{p|Ludicolo}}.
* Sapphire defeats [[Team Aqua]], but they successfully steal the [[Devon Parts|Devon Goods]].
* [[Mr. Stone]] gives Sapphire a [[letter]] for {{Steven}}.
* Ruby is rescued by [[Mr. Briney]] at sea.
* Ruby meets [[Steven Stone]].
* [[Blaise]] obtains the [[Submarine Explorer 1]] submarine for [[Team Magma]].
* [[Norman]] successfully finds Ruby.
* Ruby faces his father in battle to force him to let him do Contests. 
* Norman allows Ruby to participate in Pokémon Contests.
* [[Shelly]] and {{adv|Amber}} capture [[Flannery]] as a way to lure Sapphire.
* Sapphire faces [[Matt]] in battle to rescue Flannery.
* Team Aqua goes to stop Mt. Chimney's activity.
